purpose: Teach: 取りまとめ/ファックス/激励/主査/次官/母体/個室/衣服

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、各部の意見の取りまとめを健二に任せる
lines.en: I'm putting you in charge of collecting input from all departments on this.
lines.style: Measured authority. Crisp, direct opening. Expectation clear in the cadence — not a request. Steady breath control. The tone of someone who has already thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ファックスでの取引先連絡も継続します
lines.en: Understood. I'll continue coordinating with our trading partners by fax as well.
lines.style: Respectful, professional. Quick nod in the voice at "Understood." Even delivery, confirming competence. No flourish — just clear acknowledgment of the next thing to do.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、若手社員への激励の言葉を忘れるな
lines.en: And don't forget to give the younger staff some words of encouragement.
lines.style: Slight shift to something warmer, but still commanding. A gentle reminder tucked inside the directive. Softer attack than the first line, but the underlying expectation remains firm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。主査クラスの会議を毎週おこないます
lines.en: Yes. I'll set up weekly meetings with the subsection chiefs.
lines.style: Businesslike, grounded. Picking up the thread immediately. No pause — just moving into the next task with quiet efficiency. The reliability showing through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の元次官との会食も検討しろ
lines.en: Look into a dinner with the retired vice-minister from the industry association as well.
lines.style: Clipped, matter-of-fact. Another item, another directive. Confident the person will handle it. No elaboration — the stakes are implied in the casualness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社母体の財務状況を再確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll double-check our parent company's financial position.
lines.style: Steady, noting the shift in subject. Not rushed. A slight lowering in intensity — this is maintenance, important maintenance. Calm hand on the wheel.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員会議室の個室管理も徹底しろ
lines.en: Make sure the executive conference room stays properly secured and managed.
lines.style: Sharp, direct. Non-negotiable. Brief pause after the opening word for emphasis. The kind of instruction that expects no questions, just execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員制服の衣服デザインも刷新します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also oversee updating the employee uniform designs.
lines.style: Accepting the final directive with the same steady tone. A small sense of wrapping up — not slowing, but acknowledging this is the last item. Professional close.
